result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock. The full offline suite passes (607 tests, 0 failures).

**Change:** in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `listStockByWarehouse` (around line 1490) now has `AND s.quantity > 0` in its WHERE clause. This matches the filter the other stock overviews already use. I split the SQL string across two lines to keep the line length reasonable.

`StockService.getQuantity` is unchanged, so asking for the nuts quantity in WH-1 still returns 0.

I did not commit. I did not add a regression test for the WH-1 example (bolts and nuts); say if you want one in `StockOverviewTest`.
